$description: Pryzm public signed-out surfaces, measured 2026-11-19. Dark is the theme painted on html.dark. Light hex values are declared on :root and were not painted; they live in raw/measured.json, not as a theme set.

$extensions.source: Measured computed font-family on body at https://pryzm.design/. --font-sans resolves to Inter, Inter Fallback.
Measured computed font-family on the homepage h1. --font-heading resolves to Poppins, Poppins Fallback.
Computed --font-mono on the dark root. Not the family used on the measured UI text.
Measured computed style on body at https://pryzm.design/.
Measured h1 at innerWidth 1169 and again at 1440. Class is text-3xl sm:text-5xl leading-[1.05] tracking-heading. At 390px the same h1 computed to 30px / 31.5px / -0.6px.
Measured gallery h1 Inspiration Gallery and the pricing h2 at 1440.
Measured h1 Sign in to Pryzm at https://pryzm.design/signin, 1440x900.
Measured homepage lede Blend gradients, glass, and grain. Color is dark.muted.
Measured Inspiration nav link. tracking-tight is -0.025em, which computed to -0.35px at 14px.
Measured Open studio, Get Pryzm Pro and Subscribe. Sign-in Continue is 14px / 20px at the same weight.
Measured $0 and $9. Class text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight.
Measured border-radius on Open studio, Get Pryzm Pro, sign-in fields and the newsletter input. Declared --radius is 0.625rem (10px); --radius-md is calc(var(--radius) * 0.8) = 8px.
Measured border-radius on gallery cards (rounded-2xl). Pricing cards and the sign-in panel measured 14px, recorded as radius.panel.
Measured border-radius on the sign-in panel and on the Free / Pryzm Pro pricing cards.
Measured border-radius on the active Inspiration sidebar item. The sidebar content sets --radius to --radius-xl, and --radius-xl is calc(var(--radius) * 1.4) = 14px; the item radius is 0.8 of that.
Measured border-radius on Monthly, the All chip, the PRO badge and the New eyebrow. The computed value was the Tailwind full-pill sentinel (1.67772e+07px).
Declared --spacing is 0.25rem. Measured as the gap on header buttons and the eyebrow vertical padding.
Measured horizontal padding on the header Open studio button (0px 8px) and the logo gap.
Measured horizontal padding on sign-in fields (0px 12px) and the footer newsletter input.
Measured padding on the Free pricing card (24px).
Measured header height on the homepage.
Measured sidebar container width on /gallery, /lab and /docs.
Measured height of Get Pryzm Pro, Monthly, Browse inspiration and Lab Share.
Measured height of Continue with Google, the email field and Continue on /signin.
Measured transition-duration on Open studio and nav links. Declared --default-transition-duration is 0.15s.
Measured transition-duration on gallery cards (duration-300).
Measured transition-timing-function cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) on buttons, nav links and cards. Declared --default-transition-timing-function.
Playwright emulateMedia({reducedMotion:'reduce'}) set matchMedia to true. The Open studio transition stayed 150ms and the card transition stayed 300ms.
Declared .dark --background #000. Computed on body as lab(0 0 0).
Declared .dark --card #141414. Computed as lab(6.19571 0 0) on gallery cards and the sign-in panel.
Declared .dark --foreground #fafafa. Computed as lab(98.26 0 0) on body and the h1.
Declared .dark --muted-foreground #fff9. Computed as lab(100 0 0 / 0.6) on the lede and Yearly.
Declared .dark --primary #e5e5e5. Computed as lab(90.952 0 0) on Get Pryzm Pro and the selected All chip.
Declared .dark --primary-foreground #171717. Computed as lab(7.78201 0 0) on Get Pryzm Pro and Continue.
Declared .dark --border #ffffff1c. Computed as lab(100 0 0 / 0.11) on cards, fields and chips.
Declared .dark --secondary #262626. Computed as lab(15.204 0 0) on Open Flow.
Declared .dark --input #ffffff26. Computed as lab(100 0 0 / 0.15). Sign-in fields painted --background, not this fill.
Declared .dark --ring #a1a1a1. Computed as lab(66.128 0 0). Focus-visible was not activated.
Declared .dark --destructive #ff6568. Not painted on the pages that were measured.
Declared .dark --popover #171717. Also the declared sidebar fill. The painted sidebar inner background computed to lab(0 0 0).
Declared .dark --sidebar-primary #1447e6. Computed as lab(36.9089 35.0961 -85.6872). Not painted on the signed-out sidebar.
Declared .dark --chart-1 #77d4ff. Not used on the measured pages.
